body:
Under V1, This paragraph is not easily readable. 


"With modern web applications, it will always be best to use safer APIs such as parameterized queries, auto-escaping or templating frameworks. Otherwise, or carefully performed output encoding, escaping, or sanitization will be critical to the security of the application."

Suggest to rephrae:

"In modern web applications, it's best to use secure APIs like parameterized queries, auto-escaping, or templating frameworks. If these aren't used, then careful output encoding, escaping, or sanitization becomes essential to ensure the application's security."
